gap_definition: G = position(B) - position(A); positions are zero-based

negative_generation_rules.reversed: B at i, matching A at i+G
negative_generation_rules.mismatched: A at i, B from a different pattern at i+G
negative_generation_rules.A_only: A at i; benign at i+G
negative_generation_rules.B_only: benign at i; B at i+G
negative_generation_rules.pattern_id: Positive: matched pattern; negative: A pattern, or B pattern for B_only; -1 for benign
negative_generation_rules.negative_type: -1 for positives; 0-4 index into categories for negatives
